novel.title: Novel
sample: Qin Lang knelt below the scaffold as they dragged his father to the block.
In his last life he wept here, and three months later his family was put to death.
Now the blade had not yet fallen.
He eyed the letter in the overseer’s sleeve and stood. “Stay the blade! My father never took that silver.”
“I know where it is. In your house, my lord.”

short.title: Short story
short.promise: Write up to the first twist
sample: The night before our wedding, my fiancé gave the dress I’d sewn for three years to his first love.
“She has terminal stomach cancer. Be reasonable.”
I stared at the diagnosis and said nothing.
The doctor who signed it was me. I never wrote that report.
Three days ago I examined her myself: gastritis.
So I swapped tomorrow’s wedding slideshow for her clinic footage.

screenplay.title: Short drama script
sample: △ In front of every guest, Mrs. Gu throws a glass of red wine in Su Wan’s face.
Mrs. Gu: An orphan, marrying into the Gu family? The new owner arrives tonight. Get out.
Su Wan: (wiping off the wine) No need to wait. The owner is already here.
△ A lawyer walks past Mrs. Gu and bows to Su Wan, holding out a file.
Lawyer: Chairwoman Su, the Gu Group bankruptcy filing. Will you sign now?
